event.title: An install skill: Claude installs Predictable Code through the beta's approval
event.author: raulraja
event.body:
Companion to predictable-machines/predictable-code#3256.

A user can install this plugin first, then ask Claude to "install Predictable Code". The new `install` skill follows https://predictablecode.com/install.md:
- Claude runs the one installer and shows the GitHub code the user approves in their own browser.
- An account in the beta is installed and signed in by that single approval.
- An account not in the beta gets the Request access link, and nothing is installed.

The skill tells Claude to:
- ask before each command;
- never handle a secret;
- never pipe a download into a shell;
- stop if the account isn't admitted.

Also in this PR:
- `bin/predictable`, the SessionStart advisory and `doctor` point at the guide and the skill when `predictable` is missing. Before, they named Settings › Connected machines, which a newcomer can't reach before being admitted.
- The README install section now describes the public installer.
- `tests/validate-plugin.sh` now expects two skills (`sync` and `install`). It also checks that the install skill follows install.md and pipes nothing into a shell.

Merge after #3256 is deployed, so the guide and the signing-in installer exist when this ships.

Verified: `make lint` passes, `make test-plugin-validate` has 0 failures, and `make test-plugin-hooks` passes 103/103.
